lead: A `Core` member test's own argument bag cannot leave `headers` as `Value::null()`.
body: The compiler always passes an empty array there, so the member answers `Fatal(… expected Array for headers, got tag 0)` before it reaches what the case is about — while an unwritten *body* key is `Value::unset()`. Write `Value::array(NvsArray::new())` into that slot and release it beside the URL.
